extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Properties of air — air is everywhere, air has no colour/taste/smell, air occupies space, air has weight, air expands when heated. (2) Air pollution and causes — smoke from factories and vehicles, burning garbage and plastic, firecrackers, dust from construction, cutting trees. (3) Air-borne diseases and prevention — cold, cough, flu spread through air when sick people sneeze/cough; prevent by wearing masks, covering mouth when coughing, avoiding crowded places when sick, keeping surroundings clean. (4) Cleanliness of surroundings — throw garbage in dustbin, do not burn plastic, sweep and mop floors, plant trees, do not spit on walls, do not leave stagnant water. (5) Healthy body and mind — exercise daily, do yoga, play outdoor games, eat healthy food, wash hands before eating, read books, play with friends, sleep well, be happy. Misconceptions: 'air has no weight' (air has weight, we can feel it), 'we can see air' (air is invisible, we cannot see it but we can feel it), 'garbage on the road is fine' (garbage spreads diseases and pollutes air), 'only sick people need to be clean' (everyone needs cleanliness to stay healthy). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AirCleanGame), NOT export default. Export interface AirCleanGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
